summary: Verified that unlinking and relinking the Codex extension from the in-app registry updates the Slog UI live without restarting the agent server. Across a clean unlink/relink cycle on the Slapdash workspace with the agent-server PID unchanged, the Codex status-bar item and inspector tab disappeared on unlink and returned on relink.
decisions: A successful registry action now calls `reloadExtensions` on the client; a failure there is logged and does not mask the action's own result (covered by tests both ways).
ESM cache decision: `registryUpdate` stays stale until server restart. Busting only the entry would run new code against cached dependencies, so the limitation is commented at the call site.
The once-per-boot project service registry limitation is commented in `server.ts`.
Reconnect must call the same rebind step a thread switch uses after its snapshot arrives, otherwise a reconnect to a new server process never re-arms the project watch, model catalog, or commands.
